title: Guard coarse density image layout and visibility in mesh mode (fix 09600)
purpose: Eliminate layout mismatch between descriptor-recorded layout and current subresource layout for coarse image mips.

steps.detail: Ensure descriptors for coarse image are written with the same layout they will be sampled from in mesh pass (GENERAL if needed).
Add per-mip VkImageMemoryBarrier2 transitions only when their state actually changes. Keep a small state cache to avoid flipping every frame.
Do not transition coarse mips inside dynamic rendering. Move transitions to compute path and end with a stable layout before graphics.

acceptance: No VUID-09600 spam during mesh draws
Coarse mips retain expected layout across frames
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('image layout must match descriptor layout 09600')
